source: rlights.h as shipped in raylib 6.0 examples/shaders/rlights.h (and examples/models/rlights.h)

CreateLight.scope: Below MAX_LIGHTS an enabled light with the shader locations of lights[count] (sent with UpdateLightValues) and the count + 1; at MAX_LIGHTS a zero light and the count kept.
gaps: lightsCount is a Lights value the program threads (language adaptation)
Shader locations are -1 on the software renderer: a shader with uniforms is not verified
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

UpdateLightValues.scope: SetShaderValue of the enabled state and type (ints), position and target (vec3) and color (vec4 of c/255); the software renderer ignores them.
gaps: raylib reads the bool enabled through an int pointer; Jonlights sends 0 or 1
Uniform effects are not verified: the software renderer has no shaders
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

Light.scope: Every field; type is kind (a Bend keyword) and the color a Color word.

RLIGHTS_H.scope: The include guard: a Bend import loads the module once.

RLIGHTS_IMPLEMENTATION.scope: The implementation switch: importing the module brings its definitions.
